contexts.text: [BASELINE] Canonical task wording.

Plan delivery runs for the shop vans so they leave and return to the store, deliver groceries to every address exactly once without exceeding the cargo limit of any van, and keep the total driving distance as small as possible.

Lay out mail carrier rounds that start and finish at the post office, hand off mail to every recipient exactly once while keeping each mailbag within its carrying capacity, and minimize the overall route mileage.

Create bus runs that depart from and come back to the district garage, pick up every student exactly once while not overfilling any bus beyond its seating capacity, and minimize the sum of all route lengths.
Organize catering delivery trips beginning and ending at the kitchen, deliver orders to each event exactly once with each vehicle kept within its payload limit, and aim to minimize total travel.
Schedule mobile nurse rounds so each tour starts and ends at the clinic, visit each patient exactly once without exceeding the equipment load of any vehicle, and reduce the combined driving distance.
Plan florist van routes that start and finish at the shop, drop bouquets at every address exactly once while keeping each van under its load allowance, and minimize total kilometers traveled.

Design sanitation truck circuits that originate and return to the depot, empty each pickup point exactly once ensuring no truck is filled beyond capacity, and minimize the distance driven across all circuits.

Map beverage delivery loops that begin and end at the warehouse, serve every retailer exactly once while keeping each truck within its carry limit, and keep cumulative travel distance as low as possible.

Plan bookmobile itineraries that leave from and return to the branch, visit each neighborhood stop exactly once without exceeding shelving capacity on any vehicle, and minimize the total route length.
Arrange specimen pickup circuits that start and end at the lab, collect from every clinic exactly once with each courier’s cooler load kept within limits, and minimize total travel distance.

Plan newspaper distribution rounds from the press so each round returns to the press, leave a bundle at every newsstand exactly once with each carrier’s bag staying within its capacity, and keep the total distance covered minimal.

Organize furniture delivery runs that begin and end at the warehouse, make a single drop at each address exactly once while ensuring no truck carries more than its load allowance, and minimize overall distance driven.

Lay out pet supply delivery routes from the hub that start and finish at the hub, serve every store exactly once keeping each vehicle’s payload under its limit, and minimize the total travel distance.

Plan equipment drop routes that originate and return to the maintenance yard, deliver tools to each crew location exactly once ensuring the weight on any truck stays within limits, and minimize the total driving distance.

Schedule technician dispatch circuits that depart and return to the service center, attend every repair call exactly once with each van’s parts inventory below capacity, and minimize the sum of route distances.

Design restocking runs from cold storage that go out and come back, restock each ice cream truck exactly once without exceeding freezer capacity on any restock vehicle, and minimize total travel distance.

Create meal kit delivery circuits that leave and return to the fulfillment kitchen, drop kits at every subscriber address exactly once while keeping each van under its load limit, and reduce the total kilometers driven.

Plan blood mobile routes that depart and return to the hospital, visit each community site exactly once ensuring refrigerator capacity in any vehicle is not exceeded, and minimize the total distance covered.

Arrange parts delivery rounds that start and end at the central warehouse, supply every technician location exactly once with no vehicle carrying more parts than its capacity, and minimize overall travel distance.

Plan daily delivery circuits from the bakery so that every customer is visited exactly once, each circuit starts and ends at the bakery, no van carries more than its load limit, and the overall driving distance is kept as small as possible.

Map pickup rounds for a dairy collection truck from the farm silo so that milk is collected from each farm exactly once, each round starts and ends at the silo, the volume gathered on any round does not go over the truck capacity, and the total driving distance is minimized.

Plan vending machine restocking trips from the distribution center so that each machine is serviced exactly once, each trip departs from and comes back to the center, the stock loaded on any trip does not exceed vehicle capacity, and the total distance driven is as small as possible.

Coordinate pharmaceutical deliveries from the main pharmacy so that every clinic receives its medicines exactly once, all delivery routes start and end at the pharmacy, no vehicle carries more than its permitted load, and the overall mileage is minimized.

Lay out restocking rounds for a grocery wholesaler from the central depot so that each store is supplied exactly once, each route starts and finishes at the depot, the total amount of goods on any route remains within the truck capacity, and the aggregate travel distance is minimized.

Organize a collection schedule for a recycling firm from the headquarters so that each collection point is visited exactly once, every circuit begins and ends at headquarters, the total recyclables collected on a circuit do not exceed vehicle capacity, and total route distance is minimized.

Plan service runs for mobile blood donation vans from the clinic so that each outreach site is attended exactly once, each run starts and ends at the clinic, the number of donors accommodated or supplies carried on a run does not surpass the van capacity, and the sum of travel distances is minimized.

Arrange a pickup plan for a compost hauling service from the yard so that every pickup location is visited exactly once, each haul departs from and returns to the yard, the load on any truck stays within its capacity, and the total distance covered is minimized.

Coordinate equipment deliveries for an event rental company from the depot so that each venue gets its gear exactly once, all delivery routes start and end at the depot, the weight loaded on any vehicle remains within its capacity, and the total travel distance is minimized.

Create mail drop routes for a community courier operating out of the sorting office so that every mailbox is served exactly once, each route departs from and returns to the sorting office, the mail load on any route does not go over vehicle capacity, and the total miles driven are minimized.

Plan supply runs for a construction material supplier from the yard so that each build site receives its delivery exactly once, every run starts at and returns to the yard, the load on any vehicle does not exceed its capacity, and the overall distance traveled is as small as possible.

Arrange beverage deliveries for a brewery from the bottling plant so that each bar is served exactly once, each delivery route begins and ends at the plant, the amount of product on any route remains within vehicle capacity, and the sum of route distances is minimized.

Arrange milk collection tours for the cooperative so each farm is visited exactly once on a trip that leaves from and returns to the creamery, with the milk hauled on any tour staying under the tanker capacity, and aim to minimize total miles driven.

Create maintenance technician loops that begin and end at the service hub, attending to every service location exactly once while the tools and parts taken on any loop respect the van carrying capacity, and reduce the cumulative travel distance as much as possible.

Map out courier loops that start at and end at the downtown hub so each client location is dropped off exactly once, ensuring the parcels on any loop are within van capacity, and minimize the total route length.

Set up school supply delivery runs from the central school store that begin and finish at the store, delivering to each classroom location exactly once while the load on any run remains within the vehicle capacity, and aim to minimize overall driving distance.

Organize a wardrobe pickup schedule for the dry cleaner where each pickup tour leaves from and returns to the shop, visiting every customer exactly once and keeping the bags on any tour within the van limit, and minimize the combined travel distance.

Devise fertilizer distribution paths from the farm supply yard that start and end at the yard so every field is served exactly once, with the load on any path not exceeding spreader capacity, and keep total miles to a minimum.

Plan a mobile pet grooming schedule that departs from and returns to the groomer’s base, visiting every client exactly once with equipment on any visit staying within the van capacity, and minimize total distance driven.

Coordinate refill runs for office supplies that start and end at the central office, delivering to each department exactly once while the cargo on any run does not exceed the truck capacity, and minimize the overall travel distance.

Design a set of water delivery circuits from the municipal yard that leave from and return to the yard so each communal tap is refilled exactly once, ensuring the water carried on any circuit stays within tanker capacity, and keep the total distance as low as possible.

Schedule a set of roadside assistance patrols that depart from and come back to the garage, attending to every reported vehicle location exactly once while the equipment carried on any patrol fits within the service vehicle capacity, and minimize the total miles driven.

I need the postmaster to assign parcel runs from the distribution center so that every address receives its parcel exactly once, every run begins and ends at the center and no van is loaded beyond its capacity, with the goal of minimizing the overall route length.

The school district planner should design bus runs from the depot that pick up each stop exactly once and that start and finish at the depot without exceeding bus seating limits, aiming to minimize the sum of travel distances.

As health coordinator, organize vaccine deliveries from the central hub so each clinic gets its allocation exactly once, each vehicle departs and returns to the hub and no vehicle carries more than its safe load, while reducing total kilometers driven.

As logistics coordinator, sequence pickup runs for household moves from the company yard such that every pickup location is visited exactly once and every run starts and returns to the yard without exceeding the truck payload, and keep the combined travel distance minimal.

The water delivery planner should route jerrycan drops from the reservoir so each farm receives its delivery exactly once, each truck leaves and returns to the reservoir and no load exceeds vehicle capacity, with the aim of minimizing total driving distance.

As the neighborhood vendor, map ice cream runs from the storage garage so each stop is served exactly once and each loop starts and finishes at the garage without overfilling the freezer van, while keeping overall travel as low as possible.

The parts manager must assign service deliveries from the parts depot so each repair site gets its parts exactly once, every delivery run starts and ends at the depot and no vehicle carries more than its allowed load, seeking to minimize aggregate route length.

Blood logistics coordinator, schedule blood runs from the blood bank so each hospital is supplied exactly once, all routes start and end at the bank and no cooler load exceeds vehicle capacity, while minimizing the cumulative travel distance.

Laundry service owner, plan pick up loops from the collection center so each household is visited exactly once and each loop originates and returns to the center with bags within the van capacity, with the aim of keeping total driving distance minimal.

Farm supply manager, route fertilizer deliveries from the supply yard so every field gets its sacks exactly once, each truck run starts and ends at the yard and no truck carries more than its rated capacity, while minimizing the overall distance driven.

Distribution manager for newspapers, arrange bundle drops from the print shop so each kiosk is restocked exactly once and each run starts and finishes at the shop with load not exceeding the vehicle limit, seeking to minimize total route length.

Restock supervisor, organize snack crate rounds from the vending warehouse so every machine is refilled exactly once and every round begins and ends at the warehouse with crates within the truck capacity, aiming to minimize the combined travel distance.

Pet supply distributor, schedule pallet drops from the wholesale hub so each store is served exactly once and each truck trip starts and returns to the hub without overloading any vehicle, while minimizing total distance traveled.
